{{Quote|Group 3, we're at the Courthouse. What's your status?''"<br />"''We've been delayed.''"<br />"''Put your speeders in gear. Things are getting pretty hot here.|Gavyn Sykes to the Group 3 leader|<ref name="BFN" />}}
'''Group 3''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of one [[V-19 landspeeder|Gian speeder]] and was formed as diversionary force by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]<ref name="BFN" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> to assist in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|recapture]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] capital, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Group 3 was responsible for escorting a [[Naboo commando transport|commando transport]]. During the battle, Group 3 became delayed and was late meeting [[Group 2]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] at the [[Theed Courthouse]]. The combined force then led the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to blow open a gate blocking their way to the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]].<ref name="BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Group 3 appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. If the commando transport is destroyed, the player, in the role of Sykes, fails the mission.
